text: The Patriots will head to Jacksonville to face the Jaguars this Sunday at 1 PM ET looking to build on last week's defensive dominance over the Steelers, though they'll do so without starting right guard Mike Onwenu, whose broken right ankle sent him to injured reserve this week—prompting the team to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the active roster and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. While TreVeyon Henderson provided an offensive spark with a touchdown run in the 20-3 victory over Pittsburgh, film review suggests Drake Maye's performance and the overall offensive rhythm remain works in progress compared to last season's Super Bowl-winning form, even if the defensive unit continues to flash the coverage prowess that shut down Aaron Rodgers and company. (Meanwhile, in more charitable news for Patriots Nation, legendary kicker Adam Vinatieri recently set a Guinness World Record by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters atop Switzerland's Jungfraujoch—because apparently even in retirement, the guy finds ways to keep his name in the record books.)
